note: Primo Brands (BlueTriton) FACTORY yard audit. Scope = 28 BlueTriton facilities from 'BT Facility List.xlsx' (factories only; the 'Freight Demo Facility' test row is EXCLUDED) PLUS 4 CEO-added sites in our live YardFlow reference set but not on the BT list (Hot Springs Factory, Hot Springs DC/WHSE, Hot Springs 2 Factory, Saratoga Spring Factory). idx 1-22 = active BT (flag=1), 23-28 = blank-flag BT (operational status verified in audit; BlueTriton closed several), 29-32 = CEO-added. scopeTag = BT-active | BT-inactive | CEO-added. 'Bottling plant' (PL) and 'DC/Warehouse' (DC/WHSE). Street addresses from Downloads/Addresses_PRIMO.xlsx where present; the rest researched in audit. NOTE: Addresses_PRIMO.xlsx lists US PL POLAND SPRING FACTORY as a Raynham MA address (375 Paramount Dr) which is the HQ, not the plant; the real Poland Spring plant is in the Poland Spring/Hollis ME area and was researched in the audit. blank-flag BT closure status is set during the deep audit.
